title: [Bug]: [Subscription Billing] Payment discount on contract invoices comes from the customer, not from the contract's payment terms
summary: Payment discount percentages on subscription billing invoices now correctly use the contract's payment terms instead of the customer or vendor's payment terms.
key_points: Fixed invoice payment discount calculation to respect contract payment terms rather than customer/vendor payment terms
Added validation of Payment Terms Code after document date is set to trigger recalculation
Handles sales and purchase invoices differently based on how their payment terms validation works
Added four new tests covering scenarios where contract terms grant discounts the customer/vendor do not, and vice versa
Resolves issue where invoice discount percentage could be 0% or higher than contract allows
